BiblicalUsage: David says the wicked press him because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked, for they cast iniquity on him and hate him in anger. The word is constraint, the weight of being hemmed in by people who mean harm.
TheologicalSignificance: Oppression is real, and David's answer is to cry out to God rather than to carry it alone.
